subject: Proposal: convert intro demo into technical evaluation workshop and consolidate invites
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Erin O'Connor <erin.oconnor@greenlineretail.com>, Timothy Blake <t.blake@greenlineretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: convert intro demo into technical evaluation workshop and consolidate invites

Hi Erin / Tim —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our chat, you had penciled in a 45-minute intro demo next week (Nov 24) — given GreenLine's procurement timeline and the exec travel you mentioned, I wanted to propose we convert that session into a 2-hour technical evaluation workshop instead.

Rationale:
- We can cover architecture fit, security controls, and a hands-on scoping exercise in one slot (reduces follow-up back-and-forth).
- It gives your engineering and procurement teams enough detail for internal sign-off and speeds up the SOW review.

Proposed options:
1) Mon, Nov 30 — 09:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
2) Tue, Dec 1 — 11:00–13:00 PT

I attached an initial SOW (SOW-draft-v1.pdf) and a short agenda (workshop-agenda.docx). If we switch to the workshop I'll cancel the Nov 24 placeholder and send a single calendar invite so we don't double-book everyone.

If Nov 30 looks doable for you, we’ll have Laura Bennett (solutions engineering) join plus a backend engineer to run the scoping lab.

Next steps: let me know which option works and any required attendees on your side.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Erin O'Connor <erin.oconnor@greenlineretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Blake <t.blake@greenlineretail.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: convert intro demo into technical evaluation workshop and consolidate invites

Thanks Jonas — this makes sense.

Quick context: our head of Platform and our VP of Product are both traveling the week of Nov 24 (returning the 29th). Procurement would like a single technical session they can attend or watch a recording of; the SOW detail will help.

Nov 30 09:00–11:00 PT should work on our side — could you expand the session to include a 30–45 minute hands-on scoping exercise? We want to align on integration points (data connectors, retention, and key management).

Also please include Marissa Cole from your team (we met briefly during the pilot discussion) and copy any engineers who'll run the lab. Finally, can you attach a one-page pre-read for our procurement team?

Erin O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering | GreenLine Retail
erin.oconnor@greenlineretail.com | +1 (212) 555-3241

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Erin O'Connor <erin.oconnor@greenlineretail.com>, Timothy Blake <t.blake@greenlineretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: convert intro demo into technical evaluation workshop and consolidate invites

Perfect — Nov 30 09:00–11:00 PT is confirmed tentatively on our side. Agenda will be:
- 09:00–09:20: Executive summary & success criteria (Jonas / Erin)
- 09:20–10:00: Architecture deep-dive (Laura + Marcus)
- 10:00–10:45: Hands-on scoping lab (engineer-run, sample data)
- 10:45–11:00: Next steps + SOW review (Jonas / Marissa)

Attachments: I uploaded SOW-draft-v2.pdf (updates per your procurement notes) and a short pre-read (pre-read.pdf) to the shared Drive link below. We'll send a consolidated calendar invite and mark the Nov 24 slot as canceled to avoid duplicates.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cGreenLineWorkshop

If you confirm, I'll route the DocuSign SOW and share the final calendar invite.

—Jonas

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin O'Connor <erin.oconnor@greenlineretail.com>, Timothy Blake <t.blake@greenlineretail.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: convert intro demo into technical evaluation workshop and consolidate invites

Thanks team — happy to lead the architecture deep-dive. Marcus Lin will join me for the KV/cache and quantization discussion; Marissa, do you want to own the SOW walkthrough?

Practical note: for the hands-on lab we'll need a small sample dataset and a staging API key. Erin — can you confirm whether the sample data can be shared via the secure Drive folder, or if we should use a synthetic set? If procurement needs redaction, we can run with synthetic and show the integration flow.

I also recommend we split the lab into two short exercises (10–15 min each) so we can capture requirements in real time. I'll draft a scope-template and add it to the Drive folder by Monday.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

---

From: Erin O'Connor <erin.oconnor@greenlineretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Blake <t.blake@greenlineretail.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: convert intro demo into technical evaluation workshop and consolidate invites

All good on our side — Nov 30 09:00–11:00 PT confirmed.

Action items for Redwood:
- Final calendar invite (please cancel Nov 24 placeholder)
- DocuSign link for the SOW (we can get procurement to sign after the session)
- One-page pre-read (procurement will review ahead of the session)

We can share a redacted sample dataset in the Drive folder; I'll upload it to the shared link by Tue EOD. Looking forward to the session.

Erin

Attachments referenced in thread: SOW-draft-v1.pdf; SOW-draft-v2.pdf; workshop-agenda.docx; pre-read.pdf
